sub_questions: What does rooting an LG webOS TV enable that is impossible on stock webOS (Luna Service Bus ACLs, filesystem, systemd, privileged APIs)?
What is the complete stock vs rooted capability audit per service/path/method and which new HA entities each unlocks?
What are all bidirectional Home Assistant <-> LG TV integration possibilities (HA->TV control and TV->HA sensing) with and without the native app?
How can the HA integration auto-detect root at setup (telnet/luna/overlay/webosbrew signals) without credentials?
How can the HA integration offer user-consented auto-installation of the companion IPK (Homebrew service vs appInstallService vs ares-install) and handle updates/rollback/version pinning?
What should the native webOS app architecture be (Enact/React vs vanilla JS service, foreground UI + JS service + systemd companion, lifecycle and keep-alive vs sam/memoryd kills)?
How should the native app package, sign, and distribute as IPK (ares-cli, appinfo.json/services.json requiredPermissions, Homebrew Channel vs LG store)?
How should the native app communicate with HA (mDNS/SSDP advertisement, persistent WebSocket/MQTT/REST/SSE, capability negotiation, reconnection)?
What is the security and pairing model (re-use bscpylgtv client-key, token rotation, TLS on LAN, minimal permissions)?
What does Home Assistant Quality Scale Platinum require and how does it map to the native app and the sister integration?
What is the sister integration second-mode design (detection, config/reauth flow, coordinator push vs poll, new entities, fallback when app missing, migration, tests)?
What is the ultimate, mind-blowingly useful application — TV as full HA edge node (dashboard renderer, HDMI-CEC hub, camera/ambient via piccap, voice satellite, automation triggers)?
What is the phased delivery roadmap with clusters, risks, and per-cluster verification?
What are the adversarial limits (firmware OTA breaking root, background kills, SoC/memory constraints, security surface, store distribution blocked, fragmentation OSE vs TV)?
